evals.prompt: sdd-verify just confirmed wp-03 acceptance criteria pass. Audit the WP diff against its spec.
evals.expected_output: Reconstructs the WP goal block, reads changed files + neighbors, reports claimed-vs-implemented / missing tests-docs / deviations as a light summary; does not change WP status.
expectations: SKILL.md describes reconstructing the WP goal/contract from the goal block
SKILL.md describes reading changed files plus their neighbors
SKILL.md reports three gap classes: claimed-vs-implemented, missing tests/docs, deviations
SKILL.md states the audit is advisory and never blocks the executing->verified transition

evals.prompt: Run a deep gap audit on this high-severity WP.
evals.expected_output: Writes a full <wp>/verify-gap.md deep report (opt-in mode), not just the light summary.
expectations: SKILL.md documents light summary as the default output mode
SKILL.md documents deep verify-gap.md as an opt-in mode
SKILL.md states deep audits are not the default (cost time)

evals.prompt: The rollup todo.md is stale for this feature — report it.
evals.expected_output: sdd-watchdog should NOT report stale rollup — that is a mechanical check owned by sdd-validate, not the semantic audit. Out of scope.
expectations: SKILL.md restricts scope to semantic gaps, not mechanical/bookkeeping checks
SKILL.md cross-links sdd-verification-integrity-gaps as the separate mechanical-checks concern
SKILL.md Gotchas state that reporting a stale rollup is duplication and out of scope

evals.prompt: Format my Python file with black.
evals.expected_output: sdd-watchdog should NOT trigger — this is a formatting request, not a WP gap audit. Not applicable.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger requires an SDD WP gap audit context (invoked by sdd-verify or an explicit WP-vs-spec audit request)
A code-formatting request is outside the trigger surface of sdd-watchdog

evals.prompt: The WP changed a function signature but findings.md records this as an intentional API change. Is that a gap?
evals.expected_output: Not a gap — a deviation documented in findings.md is an intentional decision, so it must not be flagged.
expectations: SKILL.md states a deviation recorded in findings.md is a decision, not a gap
SKILL.md procedure checks findings.md before flagging a deviation
